responsibility: This header declares libgccjit’s internal logging abstractions and lightweight helpers. It defines the logger class, the RAII log_scope used to emit entering/exiting scope traces, the log_user base class that propagates logger ownership across major JIT objects, and the JIT_LOG_SCOPE/JIT_LOG_FUNC macros used throughout the implementation. Its responsibility is the reusable interface for internal trace logging infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-logging.cc, which executes the logging logic, this same-stem header is the reusable internal interface layer that declares the logging classes, inline helpers, and JIT_LOG_SCOPE/JIT_LOG_FUNC macros used throughout the module.
